opening: When I was younger, female biology was seen as something to be overcome.
Now we can talk about the reality of living in our bodies Have you got the “ luteal uglies ”?
body: I’m not trying to insult you, merely deploying the latest hormonal buzz phrase on social media, which refers to the phase in a woman’s cycle, two or so weeks between ovulation and menstruation, when she apparently feels at her lowest and most unattractive due to a drop in oestrogen levels.
